name: RSI Boot
description: Helps the AI remember this repo: rules to follow, things not to do, and how past bugs were fixed.
description_zh: 让 AI 记住这个仓库怎么写代码：要遵守的写法、不能做的事、以前的 bug 是怎么改的。下次打开这个项目会照着做，换编辑器也不用重讲。
description_en: Helps the AI remember this repo: rules to follow, things not to do, and how past bugs were fixed.
examples_zh: 我们这个仓库函数名用下划线，别写成驼峰，你记下
动手前先告诉我，这个项目有哪些规矩不能破
这个崩溃是没判空造成的，记下来，以后别再这么写
支付日志里不能打卡号，我以前跟你说过，还记得吗
examples_en: Function names in this repo use snake_case, not camelCase. Remember that
Before you start, tell me which rules in this project must not be broken
That crash was a missing null check. Remember it so we don't write it that way again
I told you before not to put card numbers in payment logs. Do you still remember?
